ftf.description: Tell someone how to get their FTF (First To Find) noticed on Project-GC.

responses.ftfInfo: There are two ways for Project-GC to detect your FTFs (**F**irst **T**o **F**inds). Either you tag your logs with one of these tags: `{*FTF*}`, `{FTF}`, or `[FTF]`. Alternatively you can add an FTF bookmark list under Settings (<https://project-gc.com/User/Settings/>) that will be checked once per day. Please understand that FTF isn't anything offical and not everyone tags their FTFs. Therefore this list won't be 100% accurate.
